answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose THREAD, a new logic-based data organization paradigm designed to handle how-to questions.
answer_1.outputs: Generated responses to how-to questions in step-by-step format, including actions, decisions, and code blocks.

answer_2.quote: We adapt the evaluation metrics from , which include: Element Accuracy (Ele. Acc) to evaluate the chosen HTML element; Operation F1 (Op. F1) to calculate the token-level F1 score for predicted operations such as "CLICK", "TYPE IN", etc.; Step Success Rate (Step SR)...

answer_3.quote: We leverage LLMs to extract "Action Items" from each ground truth step and generated step, and we use the following metrics: Precision... Recall... F1; and Success Rate (SR) to assess if the generated steps can successfully complete the task, using LLMs to evaluate (Appendix B.3 shows the evaluation prompt).

answer_4.quote: we conduct a human evaluation with twenty on-call engineers (OCEs) responsible for incident mitigation. Each OCE mitigates five incidents, with baseline methods randomly assigned per incident to prevent familiarity bias.
answer_4.guideline: Incidents are divided into simple and hard groups. OCEs intervene when the system fails, and we measure human intervention rate, success rate, and interaction turns.
